LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USES 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES: NOUNS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you show the number of things you have?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify plurals of regular and irregular nouns for effective communication
2. use plurals of regular and irregular nouns in spoken and written language for communication clarity

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns

Teach
• Focus skill: identify plurals of regular and irregular nouns for effective communication.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Grammar in uses 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you show the number of things you have?
2. Which things do we have in our classroom?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
